question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and security apparatus underpins trader consensus that he will remain in power through 2026, with no formal term limits or designated successor creating near-term pressure ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Recent personnel shifts, including military leadership changes in early 2026, have reinforced elite alignment around continuity rather than disruption. Absent public health disclosures, policy reversals, or visible factional challenges, traders assign minimal probability to removal before year-end. An abrupt elite realignment, serious health event, or destabilizing external shock could still shift outcomes in the narrow remaining window.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:
